root_divisor_controls.script:
from fractions import Fraction as Q
from itertools import combinations
from math import gcd
import json

def norm(x):
    f=x//1
    return min(x-f,1-(x-f))

counts=dict(contracts=0,old_safe=0,signed_normalizations=0,nonprimitive=0,below_old_max=0,closed_equality=0)
for N in range(3,7):
  for D0 in range(2,6):
    for size in range(1,4):
      for base in combinations(range(1,5),size):
        V=tuple(D0*v for v in base);D=gcd(*V)
        for p in range(1,14):
          g=gcd(D,p);m=D//g
          if 2*m>N*(m-1):continue
          counts['contracts']+=1
          counts['nonprimitive']+=g>1
          counts['below_old_max']+=p<=max(V)
          for a in V:
            oldsafe=[];newsafe=[]
            for r in range(N*a):
              if r%N==0:continue
              t=Q(r,N*a)
              if not all(norm(v*t)>=Q(1,N) for v in V):continue
              oldsafe.append(r);counts['old_safe']+=1
              if norm(p*t)>=Q(1,N):newsafe.append(r)
              phases=[norm(p*(t+Q(j,D))) for j in range(m)]
              assert max(phases)>=Q(m-1,2*m)>=Q(1,N)
              j=phases.index(max(phases))
              counts['closed_equality']+=max(phases)==Q(1,N)
              for signed in (r-2*N*a,r,r+N*a):
                u=signed+N*(a//D)*j
                rr=u%(N*a)
                assert 0<=rr<N*a and rr%N==r%N!=0
                assert all(norm(v*Q(rr,N*a))>=Q(1,N) for v in V+(p,))
                assert all(norm(v*Q(rr,N*a))==norm(v*t) for v in V)
                counts['signed_normalizations']+=1
            assert bool(oldsafe)==bool(newsafe)
print(json.dumps(counts,sort_keys=True))
